item.title: Create Your Layer5 Account
item.description: Your Layer5 account is your personal identity on Layer5 Cloud. One account can belong to many organizations and teams, and it is how you import and create designs, collaborate through workspaces, and connect Meshery Servers. In this tutorial you create an account, verify it, sign in, and confirm that Layer5 Cloud has prepared an organization, a team, and a workspace for you. You do not set up any of those yourself before you can start working. The Check your email page and the Import from GitHub first-run page described below arrived in Layer5 Cloud v1.0.278.

item.title: Set Up Your Organization
item.description:
An organization becomes useful when more than one person works in it. In this tutorial you invite a teammate by email, create a team, create a workspace, give the team that workspace, and move one of your designs into it. By the end you know which object controls what: the organization decides who is in, teams group people, and workspaces decide which shared resources those people reach.

Before you begin 🔗

  • You have a Layer5 Cloud account. If not, follow Create Your Layer5 Account.
  • You work in My Organization, the organization Layer5 Cloud created for you, where you hold the Organization Admin role. Any organization where your role grants the permissions below works the same way.
  • You own at least one design. If you do not, clone one first with Start from a Catalog Design.

item.title: Start from a Catalog Design
item.description:
The fastest way to a working design is to start from one someone has already published. The catalog is a public collection of designs for cloud native infrastructure. In this tutorial you browse it, try a design without changing anything, and then clone it. You finish with your own private copy in your workspace and a clear picture of what a clone is and what it is not.

Before you begin 🔗

  • Browsing the catalog needs no account. Cloning does: if you do not have one, follow Create Your Layer5 Account.
  • Cloning needs the Clone Design permission. The table shows which built-in roles hold it:
Catalog permissions
Permission What it allows UserTeam AdminWorkspace AdminOrg AdminProvider Admin
Clone Design Clone any published design to customise it according to your use cases ✓Allowed ✓Allowed ✓Allowed ✓Allowed ✓Allowed
View Designs View all public and published designs of other team members and private of signed-in user ✓Allowed ✓Allowed ✓Allowed ✓Allowed ✓Allowed

1. Browse the catalog 🔗

Open the catalog and search by technology or type. Sort by Most Cloned or Most Downloaded to see what other people rely on most. Each design card shows a summary, and opening a design shows its full details. You can also download a design to work with it outside Layer5 Cloud.
